origin.description: Test whether Pearson kurtosis of a normal sample equals 3.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector. Missing values are dropped.

origin.details: The kurtosis is transformed to a normal z. less keeps the upper tail and says the kurtosis is greater than 3. greater uses one minus that tail. A negative value raised to the one-third power is NaN.
origin.value: An htest with the kurtosis, its z, and the p-value.
